nina: Quick—can we agree on an embeddings MVP for the roadmap? Sales wants higher dims but we need a pragmatic launch.

jorge: runtime constraint: uniform-dim per request. Mixed dims break batching and index ingestion. Recommend 1024 + 4096 for GA.

rachel: ops: memory math suggests caps: 2048 vectors @1024-dim, 256 @4096-dim. 8192 needs Dedicated-only nodes.

sam: product: agree on single endpoint, header pin `X-Embed-Dim`, response includes `dimension` + `billing_units`. SDK to offer pad/truncate helpers.

jorge: also require kernel-keying by (model, dim) to keep caches warm.

rachel: perf targets: p95 <= 120ms at 1024@512, p95 <= 220ms at 4096@64. I'll run smoke tests.

sam: decision: Phase 1 = dims {1024, 4096}, uniform-dim per request, header pin, caps as above. Phase 2 = evaluate 8192 with Dedicated + pricing.

deploy-bot: canary job queued: embed-mvp-1024-4096 for Sun 02:00 UTC.

nina: I'll write the spec and assign SDK + infra tasks. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
